Account snapshot: SyntheX is a mid-stage developer tools vendor building an internal code-search product for large engineering orgs. Primary ask = scale embeddings + fast reranking for code search. They ingest monorepos and private packages; expect 8-15M embeddings initially, re-indexing daily for CI changes.

Key quoted asks: "sub-100ms cold lookup + p99 under 250ms for reranked result set"; "cost per query needs to be predictable — finance modeled at max $0.003/q at 5k QPS bursts".

Security & deployment: must support SSO/SAML with IdP-initiated flows, SCIM, and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk. Default preference = Redwood Dedicated in VPC with optional on-prem connectors for air-gapped customers. Data residency: EU codebases must remain in eu-west region.

Indexing profile: continuous CI trigger -> small delta reindexes (daily full snapshots for release branches), support for upserts and live reranking pipelines. They will test mixed-size vectors (384 -> 4096 dim for dense code embeddings) and want Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization and batching.

Internal dynamics: CTO (Evan R.) is technical champion; Head of Infrastructure (Rina K.) cares about network egress and KMS/HSM. Legal/secuity loop is slow — asking for SOC2 report and pen test summary. Pricing sensitivity: prepared to commit to Dedicated if ARR ~200k+ and if unit economics meet the modeled CPQ.
